::: {.learning-worlds-intro}
::: {}
This is an **optional way to explore** the course. It does not replace the normal menus, search, lesson pages, or teacher directions. Start at the Technology Commons Hub, travel to a connected stop, and open the lesson when you are ready.
:::

::: {.learning-worlds-reminder}
**Visited ≠ mastered.** A checkmark only means that this browser opened the stop. It is not a grade and it does not lock or unlock class content.
:::
